services.name: Fitness class
services.desc: Move your body, meet your people and spend the afternoon feeling good at the Girl, I Needed This Pilates Social in partnership with JETSET Pilates. Hosted at Ember Music Hall, this women-centered wellness experience brings together movement, music and meaningful connection in a setting that feels more like a day party than a traditional fitness class. The experience will begin with an energizing, beginner-friendly Pilates class led by JETSET Pilates. After class, stay to connect, enjoy specialty drinks and light refreshments, and shop a curated selection of women-owned wellness, beauty and lifestyle businesses. Please bring a Pilates or yoga mat and the attire theme is autumn colors.

services.name: Private Events

Our space combines the perfect capacity for Richmond events with top-tier audio-visual (AV) and lighting equipment-eliminating the need for costly AV vendors and making us a unique, budget-friendly choice. We’re proud to offer a full-service experience with some of Richmond’s finest sound technicians, L1 lighting professionals, and bar staff, ensuring smooth, high-quality events.
